entities.name: Ángel Espada
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ángel Luis "Cholo" Espada Mangual is a Puerto Rican former professional boxer. He was the WBA's world Welterweight champion in 1975-76. A music lover, Espada also organized, during the late 1970s, a salsa orchestra.
